words.gloss: of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants

hindi: पैदल सैनिकों, घोड़ों, रथों और हाथियों के लिए युद्ध में और पड़ाव में अपनी-अपनी (अनुकूल) भूमि वांछित है।
english: For foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants, their own (suitable) ground is desired in battle and in encampment.
notes: sva-bhūmi: the ground proper to each arm of the army.

words.gloss: of those who fight in desert, forest, low land and high dry land
of those who fight in trenches, in the open, by day and by night
of (those) from rivers, mountains, marshes and lakes

hindi: मरुभूमि, वन, निचली भूमि और ऊँची सूखी भूमि में लड़ने वाले, तथा खाइयों में, खुले मैदान में, दिन में और रात में लड़ने वाले पुरुषों के लिए, और नदी, पर्वत, दलदल तथा सरोवर (प्रदेशों) के हाथियों और घोड़ों के लिए, अपने-अपने (स्वभाव के) अनुसार युद्धभूमियाँ और काल वांछित हैं।
english: For men who fight in the desert, in forests, on low ground and on high dry ground, and for those who fight in trenches, in the open, by day and by night, and for elephants and horses from rivers, mountains, marshes and lakes, battle-grounds and times are desired according to the nature of each.
notes: iṣṭā before yuddha-bhūmayaḥ: iṣṭāḥ with visarga dropped before y- (sandhi); treated as f. nom. pl. khanaka: 'digging', i.e. fighting from trenches/pits; alternative 'sappers'. nādeya etc. refer to the regions the animals come from.

words.gloss: not (obstructed by) trees, shrubs, creepers... (compound continues in next token)
...stumps, fields, holes, anthills, sand and mud (continuation: not made impassable by these)
words.gram: f. nom. sg., bahuvrīhi, final members

hindi: रथों की भूमि वह है जो समतल, दृढ़ और खुली हो, जिसमें गड्ढे न हों, जो पहियों और खुरों को (क्षति) न पहुँचाए, धुरी को न फँसाए, जो वृक्ष, झाड़ी, लता, ठूँठ, खेत, गड्ढे, बाँबी, रेत और कीचड़ से दुर्गम न हो, और दरारों से रहित हो; हाथियों, घोड़ों और मनुष्यों के लिए समतल और विषम दोनों (भूमि) युद्ध में और पड़ाव में उपयुक्त है।
english: Ground for chariots is one that is level, firm and open, free from pits, not hurting wheels and hooves, not catching the axle, not made impassable by trees, shrubs, creepers, stumps, fields, holes, anthills, sand and mud, and free from crevices; for elephants and horses, and for men, ground both even and uneven is suitable in battle and in encampment.

text_flags.why: possible: the '.' after -nya treats the final -y- as a compound member; the sandhi is nirutkhātinī + acakra-khurā and anakṣa-grāhiṇī + a-vṛkṣa- (negative a- heads the long compound ending in bhaṅgurā)
possible: stray space and hyphen inside the compound vṛkṣa-gulma-vratatī-stambha-...-bhaṅgurā; the compound continues into the next token

notes: The negative a- in 'a-vṛkṣa-...-paṅka-bhaṅgurā' is read as governing the whole compound ('not fragile/impassable because of trees ... mud'); alternative reading: a-vṛkṣa-gulma-vratatī-stambha-kedāra-śvabhra-valmīka (devoid of these) and sikatā-paṅka-bhaṅgurā (not broken up by sand and mud) as a separate adjective. abhikāśā: 'open to view'; possibly read as one word sthirābhikāśā. Second half: even and uneven ground are both fit for elephants, horses and men.

words.gloss: with short holes that can be leapt over

hindi: घोड़ों की भूमि वह है जिसमें छोटे पत्थर और वृक्ष हों, छोटे और लाँघने योग्य गड्ढे हों, और दरारों का दोष थोड़ा हो।
english: Ground for horses is one with small stones and trees, with small holes that can be leapt over, and with only a slight defect of crevices.

words.gram: f. nom. sg., bahuvrīhi, final members

hindi: पैदल सैनिकों की भूमि वह है जिसमें बड़े ठूँठ, पत्थर, वृक्ष, लताएँ, बाँबियाँ और झाड़ियाँ हों।
english: Ground for foot-soldiers is one with big stumps, stones, trees, creepers, anthills and shrubs.
notes: sthāṇv aśma: sandhi of sthāṇu + aśma inside one compound (sthūla-sthāṇu-aśma-...-gulmā); the e-text separates the two parts by a space. sthūla may qualify all members ('big stumps, stones, trees...').

words.gloss: with passable hills, low ground and uneven places
with trees that can be trampled
with creepers that can be cut
with mud that can be broken through

hindi: हाथियों की भूमि वह है जिसमें पार किए जा सकने वाले पहाड़, निचली और विषम जगहें हों, रौंदे जा सकने वाले वृक्ष हों, काटी जा सकने वाली लताएँ हों, तोड़ा (पार किया) जा सकने वाला कीचड़ हो, और जो दरारों से रहित हो।
english: Ground for elephants is one with hills, low ground and uneven places that can be traversed, with trees that can be trampled down, with creepers that can be cut, with mud that can be broken through, and free from crevices.
notes: paṅka-bhaṅgurā: taken as 'whose mud is breakable (passable for elephants)', parallel to mardanīya/chedanīya; alternative: 'fragile because of mud' (as in unit 3, where it is negated), which would not fit a list of favourable features.

hindi: जो काँटों से रहित हो, बहुत विषम न हो, और जिसमें पीछे हटने का स्थान हो — यह पैदल सैनिकों के लिए विशेष (श्रेष्ठ भूमि) है।
english: Ground free from thorns, not very uneven, and provided with a place of retreat: this is the special advantage for foot-soldiers.
notes: pratyāsāra: 'retreat ground / reserve position behind'; alternative 'having reserves (reinforcements) behind'. atiśaya: the feature that makes ground specially excellent for that arm.

words.gloss: with a place of retreat twice as large
free from mud, water and what causes lameness

hindi: जिसमें पीछे हटने का स्थान दुगुना हो, जो कीचड़, पानी और लँगड़ाने के कारणों से रहित हो, और जिसमें कंकड़ न हों — यह घोड़ों के लिए विशेष (श्रेष्ठ भूमि) है।
english: Ground with twice the place of retreat, free from mud, water and whatever causes lameness, and without gravel: this is the special advantage for horses.

text_flags.why: possible: visarga written as h (निह्शर्करा for निःशर्करा / निश्शर्करा)

notes: khañjana: 'limping'; here anything that makes horses lame. dvi-guṇa-pratyāsārā: twice that of foot-soldiers (unit 7).

words.gloss: containing dust, mud, water, reeds and rushes
free from blows of big tree branches

hindi: जिसमें धूल, कीचड़, पानी, नरकट और सरकंडे हों, जो श्वदंष्ट्र (कँटीले पौधों) से रहित हो, और बड़े वृक्षों की शाखाओं के आघात से मुक्त हो — यह हाथियों के लिए विशेष (श्रेष्ठ भूमि) है।
english: Ground containing dust, mud, water, reeds and rushes, free from dog's-tooth thorns, and free from the striking of branches of big trees: this is the special advantage for elephants.

text_flags.why: possible: ṇṣ for ṃṣ (दण्ष्ट्र for दंष्ट्र); orthographic variant or typo

notes: śva-daṃṣṭra ('dog's tooth'): a thorny plant; glossed literally as the brief requires. nala, śara: two kinds of reed.

hindi: जिसमें जलाशय और आश्रय-स्थान हों, जिसमें गड्ढे न हों, जो खेतों से रहित हो, और जिसमें (रथ) घुमाए जा सकें — यह रथों के लिए विशेष (श्रेष्ठ भूमि) है।
english: Ground having water-reservoirs and places of shelter, free from pits, free from fields, and allowing (chariots) to turn about: this is the special advantage for chariots.
notes: apāśraya: 'support, refuge'; alternative 'places to fall back on'.

hindi: सबकी (सेना के सब अंगों की) भूमि कही जा चुकी है।
english: The ground for all (the arms) has been stated.

hindi: इसी (भूमि के विवरण) से सब सेनाओं के पड़ाव और युद्ध (भी) समझाए हुए हो जाते हैं।
english: By this, the encampments of all troops and the battles stand explained.
notes: sarva.bala.niveśā: nom. pl. with visarga dropped before y-.

words.gloss: searching of ground, camping sites and forests
securing favourable water, fords, wind and sunlight
driving off (the enemy) on the flanks
carrying off the treasury and princes
striking the rear and the wings

hindi: भूमि, पड़ाव-स्थानों और वनों की खोज; अनुकूल जल, घाट, वायु और धूप का (स्थान) लेना; (शत्रु की) रसद और सहायक सेना का विनाश या (अपनी की) रक्षा; सेना का (मार्ग) शोधन और उसे स्थिर करना; चारे-संग्रह (की सीमा) का विस्तार; पार्श्वों से (शत्रु को) खदेड़ना; पहला प्रहार; (शत्रु-सेना में) घुसना; भेदना; (अपनी सेना को) आश्वस्त करना; पकड़ना; छुड़ाना; पीछा करने के मार्ग को बदलना; कोश और राजकुमारों को हर ले जाना; (शत्रु के) पिछले भाग और पार्श्वों पर आघात; दुर्बल (शत्रु) का पीछा करना; अनुगमन; और संगठित होकर कार्य करना — ये घुड़सवार सेना के कार्य हैं।
english: Searching out ground, camping sites and forests; securing favourable water, fords, wind and sunlight; destroying (the enemy's) supply-lines and reinforcements or protecting (one's own); clearing the way for the army and steadying it; extending the range of foraging; driving off (the enemy) on the flanks; the first strike; penetrating (the enemy ranks); piercing through; rallying; capturing; releasing; changing the line of pursuit; carrying off the treasury and the princes; striking at the rear and the wings; pursuing the weakened; following up; and acting as a concentrated body: these are the functions of the cavalry.
notes: Many of these are technical military terms with disputed senses. a-viṣama-...-grahaṇam: 'taking up (positions with) water, fords, wind and sun that are not adverse'. prasāra: foraging/raiding for fodder. bāhu-utsāra: bāhu = wing/flank of the army; alternative 'repelling by force of arms'. vyāveśana / vyāvedhana: entering into and breaking through the enemy array. mārga-anusāra-vinimaya: alternative 'alternating (troops) in following a route'. samāja-karma: alternative 'work of assembling/rallying (scattered troops)'. koṭi: tip/wing of an array.

words.gloss: making roads, camps and fords where none exist
driving off (the enemy) on the flanks
crossing water and descending into it
victory by a single arm (of the army)
carrying away the treasury and transport

hindi: आगे चलना; जहाँ मार्ग, पड़ाव और घाट न बने हों वहाँ उन्हें बनाना; पार्श्वों से (शत्रु को) खदेड़ना; जल को पार करना और उसमें उतरना; ठहरना, चलना और उतरना; विषम और सँकरे स्थानों में प्रवेश; आग लगाना और बुझाना; एक अंग (की सेना) से विजय; टूटी हुई (सेना) को जोड़ना; अटूट (सेना) को तोड़ना; विपत्ति में रक्षा; आघात; भय उत्पन्न करना; डराना; भव्यता; पकड़ना; छुड़ाना; प्राकार, द्वार और अट्टालिकाओं को तोड़ना; और कोश तथा वाहनों को हर ले जाना — ये हाथियों के कार्य हैं।
english: Marching in front; making roads, camps and fords where there are none; driving off (the enemy) on the flanks; crossing water and descending into it; halting, marching and descending; entering uneven and narrow places; setting and quenching fire; victory by a single arm (of the army); reuniting broken (ranks); breaking unbroken (ranks); protection in calamity; striking; terrifying; frightening; imposing grandeur; capturing; releasing; breaking ramparts, gates and towers; and carrying away the treasury and transport: these are the functions of elephants.

text_flags.why: the '.' joins two separate nouns (cf. 'trāsanam audāryaṃ' in 10.04.15); anusvāra before a vowel is also irregular

notes: sthāna-gamana-avataraṇam: alternative 'descending (from the elephant) while standing or moving'. audārya: 'magnificence', the imposing presence of elephants. vāhana: 'conveyances / draught animals'.

hindi: अपनी सेना की रक्षा; (शत्रु की) चतुरंग सेना को रोकना; संग्राम में पकड़ना और छुड़ाना; टूटी हुई (सेना) को जोड़ना; अटूट (सेना) को तोड़ना; डराना; भव्यता; और भयंकर घोष — ये रथों के कार्य हैं।
english: Protecting one's own army; repelling the (enemy's) fourfold army; capturing and releasing in battle; reuniting broken (ranks); breaking unbroken (ranks); frightening; imposing grandeur; and a terrible noise: these are the functions of chariots.
notes: catur-aṅga-bala: the army of four arms (foot, horse, chariot, elephant).

words.gloss: carrying weapons in all places and at all times

hindi: सब स्थानों और सब समयों में शस्त्र धारण करना, और व्यायाम (युद्ध-श्रम) — ये पैदल सैनिकों के कार्य हैं।
english: Carrying weapons in all places and at all times, and exertion (in fighting): these are the functions of foot-soldiers.
notes: vyāyāma: here the physical exertion of combat; glossary sense 'activity' is from 6.2 and not meant here.

words.gloss: the work of clearing camps, roads, bridges, wells and fords
carrying machines, weapons, armour, implements and food
removing weapons, armour and the wounded

hindi: शिविर, मार्ग, पुल, कुएँ और घाट साफ़ करने का काम; यन्त्र, आयुध, कवच, उपकरण और भोजन ढोना; और रणभूमि से शस्त्र, कवच और घायलों को हटाना — ये विष्टि (श्रमिक दल) के कार्य हैं।
english: The work of clearing camps, roads, bridges, wells and fords; carrying machines, weapons, armour, implements and food; and removing weapons, armour and the wounded from the battlefield: these are the functions of the labour corps (viṣṭi).
notes: viṣṭi: forced labour / the labour corps attached to the army. śodhana: clearing or making ready.

words.gloss: mixed yoking of oxen and horses

hindi: जिस राजा के पास घोड़े कम हों, वह रथों में बैलों और घोड़ों को मिलाकर जोते; और जिसके पास हाथी कम हों, वह उसी प्रकार गधों, ऊँटों और गाड़ियों का (सेना के) मध्य भाग बनाए।
english: A king who has few horses should yoke oxen together with horses to his chariots; and one who has few elephants should likewise make a core (of the array) out of donkeys, camels and carts.
notes: Verse (two 16-syllable half-lines). garbha: the inner part/centre of a battle array, here formed by pack animals and carts in place of elephants. vyāyoga: yoking of different animals together.
